scope: Deterministic equal-moment counterexample and common-prediction lower bound, not method effectiveness gate, not old fixture replay.
screen: All same-mean/second-moment/unit-norm/formula checks and midpoint sharp triangle bound pass; every shared-draw prediction obeys max error>=half reference loss gap. No retuning or replacement of prior gates.
result_policy: All zero/positive gaps, both references, all methods/batches/costs retained; no optimization or query search.
